newsitem.title: USA: Record 1996/97 in U.S. aluminum shipments forecast.
newsitem.headline: Record 1996/97 in U.S. aluminum shipments forecast.

text.p: Total industry shipments of aluminum in the United States are due to hit a record 21.87 billion pounds or 9.92 million tonnes, rising a further 5.6 percent in 1997 to 23 billion pounds or 10.43 million tonnes, the National Association of Aluminum Distributors reported.
The figures, prepared by Alumax for NAAD's mid-year outlook, include exports of aluminum. Associate member companies of NAAD take turns to compile the regular report.

Service center shipments were also forecast to rise, but at a lower rate. This year distributor shipments should rise 1.7 percent to almost 2.2 billion pounds which, if achieved, would set a shipping record for the fourth consecutive year, NAAD said.
In 1997 distributor shipments are forecast to rise 4 percent to 2.25 billion pounds. At this level, shipments would be 37 percent over peak volume set in 1988.
